# InstaPact

> Instant Digital Agreements for Freelancers & Agencies. Create and sign legally binding contracts in 30 seconds.

## Description
InstaPact is a legal-tech SaaS designed to help freelancers and small agencies finalize deals faster. It simplifies the contract lifecycle by offering pre-built templates, instant digital signatures, and watermark-free downloads. 

## Key Features
- **Speed**: Finalize agreements in under 30 seconds.
- **Trust**: Standardized legal templates for common business needs.
- **Watermark-Free**: Clean, professional PDFs on premium plans.
- **Agency Tools**: Manage multiple agreements and high-volume signing.
- **Digital Signatures**: Fully legally binding digital signatures.

## Pricing
- **Free**: 1 Agreement per month (with watermark).
- **One-time**: ₹99 per document (Lifetime validity).
- **Standard**: ₹399/month for 10 documents, custom branding.
- **Agency**: ₹999/month for unlimited access.
- *Save 20% on Annual billing.*
